title: Max Harwood selected for 2026 MLS NEXT All-Star Game in North Carolina
text:
Max Harwood selected for 2026 MLS NEXT All-Star Game in North Carolina
Minnesota United and the MNUFC Academy announced on June 24 that U16/U18 midfielder Max Harwood has been chosen to play for the West Team in the fifth annual MLS NEXT All-Star Game, presented by Allstate. The event will feature top young players from across North America in an East versus West matchup at Mecklenburg County Sportsplex in Matthews, North Carolina, on Monday, July 27 at 6:30 p.m. CT. The game will be streamed live on MLS’ YouTube channel and MLSsoccer.com.
Harwood, a 16-year-old midfielder from Minneapolis, Minnesota, has been part of MNUFC’s Academy since 2023. During the 2025-26 MLS NEXT season, he played primarily with the club’s U18 side, appearing in 12 games and logging over 700 minutes. He also trained and competed with MNUFC2, making 14 appearances and playing nearly 650 minutes during the current year. Before joining MNUFC Academy, Harwood played for Keliix Intra Soccer Club in Minneapolis.
With this selection, Harwood becomes the fifth player from Minnesota United's academy to participate in an MLS NEXT All-Star Game since its inception in 2022. Previous representatives include Carlos Leatherman (2022), Kage Romanshyn Jr. (2023), Darius Randell (2024), and Tim Dennis (2025). Minnesota United has had a player represented every year of the event.
The upcoming match will feature a total of 44 players selected after the conclusion of the regular season and MLS NEXT Cup presented by Allstate. Eligibility required players to be born between 2009-2011 and have participated either during the regular season or at one of several premier events such as MLS NEXT Fest or Generation adidas Cup.
During MLS All-Star Week, Harwood and other participants will take part in programming events including team training sessions as well as attending both the Skills Challenge on July 28 and the main All-Star Game on July 29.
